title: Meeting Norman Granz and first Jazz at the Philharmonic
summary: Granz hears Hawkins at Long Beach, and McGhee negotiates fees without advice from Hawkins.

blocks.x: Now, let's dovetail back a little bit. You had been doing Jazz at the Philharmonics from the time you were in California.
What do you remember about that?
What do I remember about it? Well, what is there to remember, except...
Well, how did you meet Norman and what do you remember about...?
Oh, I was with Bean then. The first night we played at Long Beach, that was the first night we hit in California. And Norman Granz came up and heard Bean

playing, so he wanted Bean to make this concert with him. In the meantime, he heard me play and he said would I like to make it also. I said, "yeah, I'd like to make it, but I didn't know what was going on as far as bread was concerned. So I asked Bean about it: "Bean, what do you think I should charge this cat to do this concert?" Bean said, "I don't know. Whatever you want to charge him. Charge him anything." I said, "Well, you're a lot of help. I'm trying to help you; I thought maybe you'd try to help me." He said, "Well, I can't tell you what to charge nobody. You charge him what you want." And that's what happened.
Because you were on that "How High The Moon," which is the one that really put him on the map.
Yeah, it really set him off. Well, frankly, I didn't know my ass from a hole in the ground as far as my business...
